summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C contracts expiring in 2026 and 2031. While AVGO shows significant put buying ($191.4M), the dominant conviction lies in aggressive, multi-day call accumulation for SPX 7000C (exp 2026-12-18) totaling over $2B across 4 sessions. Traders should monitor for continued strength in NVDA and TSLA, which both show extreme call dominance (P/C 0.29 and 0.32 respectively), but watch for any reversal in the SPX 8000P/7700P long-dated hedges that saw nearly $700M in recent activity.
